questions.stem_text:
Exposing individuals to arguments against their views, arguments that are then strongly
refuted, may serve to

options.B: make them more susceptible to accepting opposing views
options.C: weaken their resistance to later persuasive appeals

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - make them more argumentative

questions.stem_text:
According to Harry Stack Sullivan, which of the following cognitive experiences
characterizes schizophrenic behavior:

options.A: Parataxic Distortion Mode: dealing w/ other like they're from early life
options.B: Parataxic Integration Mode: connecting unrelated events or ideas
options.C: Basic anxiety: feeling of helplessness/isolation in a hostile world
options.D: Eudaimonic Mode: pursuit of meaning and self-realization
options.E: Autistic Mode: living in a world of fantasies and daydreams

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Parataxic Distortion Mode: dealing w/ other like they're from early life

questions.stem_text: According toJellinek(1952) what progression does thelife ofan alcoholic usually follow ?

options.A: Onset phase, abuse phase, dependency phase, abstinence phase
options.B: Prealcoholic phase, alcoholic phase, recovery phase, relapse phase
options.C: Initial phase, adaptive phase, dependent phase, deteriorative phase
options.D: Experimental phase, social use phase, intensive use phase, compulsive use phase
options.E: Initial phase, middle phase, crucial phase, termination phase

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Onset phase, abuse phase, dependency phase, abstinence phase
